fact: ESCWA's 2026 review states Somalia's Social Protection Delivery System (SPDS) was designed under Baxnaano but is still limited in operation, while the Unified Social Registry holds up to 534,000 households and the Baxnaano, SAGAL and CSSP programmes have committed to using the USR and SPDS.
title: Social protection landscape and perspectives: Comprehensive national review of the system and reforms of Somalia
publisher: United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Western Asia (ESCWA)
